title: Lesson 2 Checkpoint — Should / Shouldn't
description: Show what you learned about should / shouldn't. You need at least 4 out of 5 correct to pass.
canDo: I can give advice with should and shouldn't.

questions.question: Which sentence is grammatically correct?
questions.explanation: Correct pattern for Should / Shouldn't: Should + base verb: You should rest. | Shouldn't: You shouldn't drive tired.

questions.question: Complete: ___ recommend this book.
questions.explanation: Should + base verb: You should rest. | Shouldn't: You shouldn't drive tired.

questions.question: True or false: "You should see a doctor." is correct English.
questions.explanation: This sentence follows the target grammar.

questions.question: Choose the word that correctly completes the sentence: ___ shouldn't skip meals.
questions.explanation: Should + base verb: You should rest. | Shouldn't: You shouldn't drive tired.
